title: Firm Valuation When AI Shapes the Business Model: A Milestone-Based Real-Options Framework for the AI Valuation Uncertainty Problem
abstract: arXiv:2609.24181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard valuation methods, including discounted cash flow, the income approach standard IDW S 1 of the Institute of Public Auditors in Germany, and market multiples, compress milestone probabilities, continuation options, and risk shifts into opaque aggregate parameters; none provides a structured protocol for decomposing AI integration into auditable option-level assumptions. We propose an industry-agnostic taxonomy separating AI Integrators from AI Providers. AI Integrators are further classified by their Integration Depth Level, ranging from no integration to AI at the core of the product or process. A milestone-gated real-options overlay decomposes milestone state value into five components, and an Analytic Hierarchy Process-based Success Readiness Index derives per-option probabilities from structured pairwise comparisons for scenario analysis. translated_title: 当AI塑造商业模式时的企业估值：针对AI估值不确定性问题的基于里程碑的实物期权框架
translated_abstract: 标准的估值方法，包括现金流折现法、德国公共审计师协会的收益法标准IDW S 1以及市场乘数法，都将里程碑概率、持续期权和风险转移压缩为不透明的汇总参数；没有任何一种方法提供了将AI整合分解为可审计的期权级假设的结构化协议。我们提出了一个与行业无关的分类体系，将AI整合商与AI提供商区分开来。AI整合商进一步按其整合深度级别进行分类，范围从无整合到AI处于产品或流程的核心。基于里程碑门控的实物期权叠加方法将里程碑状态价值分解为五个组成部分，而基于层次分析法（AHP）的成功准备度指数则通过结构化的两两比较推导出每个期权的概率，用于情景分析。将该框架应用于一家AI原生的能源软件即服务（SaaS）企业，该框架得出了连贯的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个与行业无关的AI企业分类体系和基于里程碑门控的实物期权估值框架，并结合层次分析法构建成功准备度指数，将AI整合价值分解为五个可审计的期权级组成部分，从而为AI估值不确定性问题提供了结构化的解决方案。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an industry-agnostic taxonomy of AI firms and a milestone-gated real-options valuation framework, combined with an AHP-based Success Readiness Index, to decompose AI integration value into five auditable option-level components, offering a structured solution to the AI valuation uncertainty problem.
